lean.name: second_derivative_test_analyticAt

statements.markdown:
If $f$ is analytic at $a$, its
gradient vanishes at $a$, and $D^2f(a)[h,h]>0$ for every $h\ne0$, then $f$
has a local minimum at $a$.
